title: Expense Agent: expose VAT setup in configuration wizard
summary: The Expense Agent Setup Wizard now exposes VAT configuration controls (Default VAT Business Posting Group, Allow VAT Reclaim, and a link to VAT Posting Setup) within the wizard interface instead of requiring administrators to leave the wizard to access these settings.
key_points: VAT configuration fields added to the accounting defaults section of the setup wizard
Controls use the existing temporary setup record and call ConfigUpdated() to mark changes without early persistence
Default VAT Business Posting Group field is positioned first to satisfy table validation requirements
Navigation to standard VAT Posting Setup page uses the same modal pattern as other wizard links
Update and Cancel operations flow through existing save/discard logic
